static_traits.name: Fang Shan
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive circle of friends，但尚not yet向他们分享该具体困扰；与同学的关系受嫉妒与Self-doubt影响
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；以往without类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理咨询或治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，逻辑性较强，能Reflection自身思维模式，配合度与求助动机较高

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得自己会一直是Student，这让我感到停滞not前，职业目标缺乏进展。
basic_info.core_demands: I realized this negative thinking pattern hinders me from taking action toward a nursing career, so I came to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: 决定重返校园攻读护理学位，最初感到兴奋，但在过去几个月里“停滞not前”的感受逐步加剧；在看到同学们获得工作机会或讨论入职时，频繁与他人比较，从而引发强烈的Self-doubt与not够好的感受；与此同时，并not yet启动求职或实习申请等具体职业行动。
既往without类似的心理困扰与治疗史，No major physical illness史。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/not如do not人
只要have not与同龄人同步达成职业进展，就证明我without法胜任

special_situations.event: Sees classmates obtaining job opportunities or discussing receiving offer letters
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我现在还have not拿到offer或开始工作，就说明I am not good enough、会被落下
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding job-seeking actions、减少与同学互动以降低比较带来的刺痛、把精力更多投入课程以证明自己
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: do not人都在前进，只有我停滞；我永远也赶not上他们

special_situations.event: 意识到自己尚not yet开始投递简历或申请岗位/实习
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我现在have not立刻采取行动并拿到结果，就等于失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinates and avoids making job-seeking plans to avoid seeing evidence of 'failure'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我一定做错了什么；我可能根本not行

special_situations.event: Hears classmates' internship or onboarding progress when communicating with them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他人已经被录用而我have not，我的前途大概率会很糟糕
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复内心比较与自我质疑，Reduced socializing以规避trigger点
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会一直是个Student；我永远也完not成

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized, prove oneself capable, and smoothly enter the nursing profession
core_conflict.fear: 害怕not够好、被比较落后与Being rejected，担心永远“停滞not前”
defense_goal: 通过Avoiding job-seeking actions以避免看到失败证据
Keeps a certain distance from classmates, reducing the activation of shame and jealousy
Directing energy toward studies to temporarily maintain self-esteem and a sense of control

object_relations.object_representation: Others/peers who progress rapidly and may be judgmental

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing or talking about classmates obtaining job opportunities and celebrating offers, or when focusing on peer progress in the session
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的成功等同为对自己的negate与失败，激发羞耻与自责（移情基础：把“被比较/not被认可”的内部图式带入当前关系）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以温和、Empathy与正常化的语气回应，先命名与接纳羞耻/嫉妒，再引导区分他人进展与自我价值，邀请识do not当下可控的小步骤，避免比较与评判性语言。

manifestations: 反复感到“停滞not前”，认为自己会一直是Student
Experiences a void and confusion about self-worth in comparison with peers
Reduced sense of control over career path; hard to see the meaning of his own actions

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁以同侪为参照进行自我评判与negate
语言中出现“I am not good enough/我做错了”的自我苛责
Reduces interaction with classmates or sharing real troubles out of worry about being judged

positive_force: 有支持性的朋友资源（尽管尚not yet分享具体困扰）
Has a clear interest and goal motivation in the nursing profession
能觉察并描述自动化思维与trigger情境
Invested in coursework; affirms the view that 'completing studies is progress'
Actively seeks psychological counseling, positive attitude
negative_force: 与同龄人进行not利的比较
灾难化与全或without思维、过度概括
Avoiding job-seeking actions与拖延，依赖外部比较来评估自我价值
Motivation and self-care decline; relationships damaged by jealousy

target_behavior.behavior: 回避求职申请与not采取具体职业步骤（拖延）
antecedent: Seeing classmates receive offers or discussing onboarding progress
想到自己尚not yet开始投递或准备应聘材料
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-doubt与对失败/被比较落后的恐惧，核心信念“I am not good enough”被激活
target_behavior.function: 短期逃避可能的失败与外界评判，降低当下Anxiety与羞耻
target_behavior.consequence: 职业进展停滞感加剧，进一步Reinforcementwithout力与Self-denial

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated social comparison and self-deprecating thinking
antecedent: Sees classmates celebrating offers or hears about their progress
target_behavior.core_reason: Uses external comparison as the main way to evaluate value, lacking inner self-affirmation
target_behavior.function: Tries to confirm self-worth and positioning (seeking external validation), but actually intensifies self-attack
target_behavior.consequence: Jealousy and inferiority increase; relationships with classmates affected

target_behavior.behavior: 学习与自我照料的Decreased motivation
antecedent: 出现“我会一直是Student”“我永远也完not成”等自动化思维
看到同学的职业进展时
target_behavior.core_reason: 灾难化、全或without思维带来without力感与despair体验
target_behavior.function: Short-term avoidance of pressure and task load, reducing immediate emotional pain
target_behavior.consequence: Academic performance affected，自我照料变差，负性循环进一步维持
